description: This file implements classes and functions related to container management within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace, including container creation, status checking, starting, stopping, and cleanup, with integration to the crun runtime.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Administrator class responsible for managing container instances, including creation and logging.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, providing methods to start, stop, check status, and manage container lifecycle.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with configuration, setting up context and logging.

methods.name: ~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor that stops the container if running and removes it from the administrator.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes any leftover containers from previous runs.
